detail.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: Autocatalytic reaction networks store non-equilibrium memory through stoichiometric submatrix conditions and emergent local interactions, distinguishing history-dependent states from simple physical hysteresis.
detail.reason: Revise the autocatalytic chemical memory notebook with newly available peer evidence covering chemical reaction networks and algorithmic enumeration of autocatalytic cores.
